Experience the beauty of the sunset on the open water with Sunset Sail Salem. Our skilled crew will guide you on a breathtaking journey as you watch the sun dip below the horizon. services.name: Sunset Sail
services.desc: Yes, it was! Built in 1939 for General George S. Patton, "When And If" was commissioned by Patton himself from naval architect John Alden, and built by FF Pendleton in Wiscasset, ME to sail around the world “When the war is over, and If I live through it.”Unfortunately, he never got the chance to sail aboard her. Fortunately, you do. Each sunset sail is 2 hours in duration, and includes complimentary bottled water and seltzer with a cash bar on board.Depending on the temperature, blankets can be provided.
